pages.title: Croptopia
pages.text:
Croptopia massively expands the crop roster and touches every food group. Its biggest impact is on $(bold)Fruits$() and $(bold)Vegetables$(), where it adds dozens of new families that make rotation trivially easy.

With Croptopia installed, maintaining a diverse diet becomes natural rather than deliberate.

pages.title: Fruits — Croptopia
pages.text:
Croptopia adds many distinct fruit families. Key ones to grow:

$(bold)Strawberry$() — fast-growing, excellent nutrition.
$(bold)Peach / Mango / Kiwi$() — tree fruits, slower but high value.
$(bold)Grape$() — vine crop; good density per plot.
$(bold)Pineapple$() — tropical; high nutrition per harvest.
$(bold)Tomato$() — fast, pairs well with vegetable rotation.

pages.title: Vegetables — Croptopia
pages.text:
Croptopia vegetable additions include:

$(bold)Corn$() — high-yield crop; excellent base vegetable.
$(bold)Onion / Leek$() — fast-growing alliums; distinct family.
$(bold)Spinach / Lettuce$() — leafy greens; quick crop cycle.
$(bold)Pepper / Chili$() — spicy vegetables; unique family.
$(bold)Artichoke / Asparagus$() — slow but high nutrition value.

pages.title: Proteins & Grains
pages.text:
Croptopia also adds to Proteins and Grains:

$(bold)Almonds / Peanuts / Cashews$() — nut-family proteins; no animal farm needed.
$(bold)Tofu$() — plant-based protein made from soybeans.
$(bold)Rice$() — adds a Grains family distinct from wheat.
$(bold)Oats / Corn Flour$() — alternative grain crops.

Nuts make a great supplemental protein for players who prefer less combat-heavy farming.

pages.title: Rotation Advice
pages.text:
With Croptopia, the main risk is $(bold)over-focusing$() on a few favourite crops and ignoring the rest. The mod gives you so many options that it is easy to default to strawberries for Fruits every day.

Set up a multi-crop farm covering at least 3 distinct families per group. Croptopia's crop variety is only an advantage if you actually use it.
